svg.text: LEFT: the upasarga engine — one atom + many preverbs → many words · MIDDLE: radiance · RIGHT: organic foreign sprout
dhātu + upasarga → many śabdāḥ · + upa · anu · apa · ā … (the engine)
KEYSTONE: sthā = stā- → stand · state · status · statue · station · stable
and स्थान (sthāna) → -stān : Afghāni-stān · Uzbeki-stān · Rāja-sthān — “place” across the map
✗ *steh₂- (reconstructed PIE) — the root the pyramid imagines
no trunk descends; the seed came from the light, not from below
